Trump rebrands AI as 'Super Intelligence' at UN, stresses US leadership

During an address at the United Nations General Assembly, U.S. President Donald Trump referred to artificial intelligence as 'Super Intelligence' (SI). He emphasized that this technology represents a global race where U.S. leadership over competitors such as China is crucial for winning. Sam Altman and Dario Amodei were also scheduled to address the UN on the same day, following Trump's rejection of global AI rules. Experts, however, express skepticism about the likelihood of Trump's 'Super Intelligence' rebrand gaining widespread adoption.
